name: Azure Step
description: Fold the near reach of space and cross it in the school's light first step.

name: Azure Palm
description: Strike with the school's open palm that lands from a fold of space beside the foe.

name: Azure Gauge
description: Take the school's measure of the distance to a foe with one clear look.

name: Azure Bind
description: Fold space over a foe's limbs in the school's pattern and pin them where they stand.

name: Azure Slice
description: Cut a clean fold through the foe's guard in the school's single stroke.

name: Azure Bulwark
description: Raise the school's guard of folded space and take the blow upon its pleats.

name: Azure Lance
description: Drive a lance of folded sky-bright space through the foe's guard and body.

name: Azure Mantle
description: Wear the school's mantle of folds that turns blows and quickens the wearer's strikes.

name: Azure Sunder
description: Pull the folds of a wide field apart in the school's way and break all that stands upon it.

name: Azure Convergence
description: The school's closing move that folds the whole field into the palm and releases it as one crushing fall.

name: Zenith Stride
description: Rise on a stretched stride that carries the body high and far in the school's first step.

name: Zenith Jab
description: Jab from the high point of the reach so the fist drops onto the foe's brow.

name: Zenith Sense
description: Read the field from the high point of the reach and see how every body is placed.

name: Zenith Pull
description: Draw a foe up onto the toes by pulling the space beneath their heels away.

name: Zenith Cut
description: Bring the hand down from the arc's peak in the school's long clean cut.

name: Zenith Brace
description: Brace under the arc so a heavy blow meets the stretched space above the head.

name: Zenith Poise
description: Hold the body at the peak of its reach so each strike that follows drops with more weight.

name: Zenith Spear
description: Hurl a spear of qi from the arc's peak so it falls point first on the foe.

name: Zenith Fall
description: Fall from the height of the reach in a straight blow with all the stretched space behind it.

name: Zenith Crown
description: Set the foe beneath the high point of the arc and bring the whole reach down upon their head.

name: Zenith Descent
description: The school's closing move that lifts the foe's whole space to the peak and drops it upon them as one fall.

name: Apogee Step
description: Step out to the far end of the stride and return in a single drawn pace.

name: Apogee Palm
description: Send a palm out to the far end of its reach and let it snap back with the blow.

name: Apogee Scan
description: Send the senses to their furthest point and read what lies at the edge of the field.

name: Apogee Bind
description: Hold a foe at the far point of their lunge so the blow can neither land nor return.

name: Apogee Cut
description: Cut at the end of a long reach where the stroke is hardest to see.

name: Apogee Guard
description: Meet a blow at the far end of its course and send it back on a longer arc.

name: Apogee Lance
description: Cast a lance to the apogee of its flight and let it fall through the foe.

name: Apogee Ward
description: Set a ward at the far point of a strike's range and strengthen those standing inside it.

name: Apogee Shatter
description: Break the far edge of a wide field inward and let the shards of space strike all within.

name: Apogee Ascendant
description: The school's closing move that carries force to its furthest point and returns it as one ascendant stroke.

name: Boundless Step
description: Take the school's open stride across space that has no fixed length.

name: Boundless Palm
description: Throw a palm whose reach is limited only by the school's will.

name: Boundless Sense
description: Let the senses run out into the school's limitless field and mark every body in it.

name: Boundless Bind
description: Stretch space about a foe until every move they make takes them nowhere.

name: Boundless Cut
description: Cut across the full width of a field in the school's single line.

name: Boundless Guard
description: Widen the space before the user until a blow dies long before it arrives.

name: Boundless Lance
description: Drive a lance across a field of no measured length to pierce a distant foe.

name: Boundless Veil
description: Spread the school's limitless veil so lesser blows lose themselves in its depth.

name: Boundless Rend
description: Tear the foe's space apart from within until no armor or ward can hold it.

name: Boundless Dominion
description: The school's closing move that spreads limitless space about the user where all other bodies are bound.

name: Breach Step
description: Breach the space ahead and step through the breach in the school's first step.

name: Breach Hand
description: Strike with a palm that breaches the space before it and lands without delay.

name: Breach Sense
description: Feel through every breach near the body and read what stands beyond each.

name: Breach Bind
description: Pull a foe half through a breach so their limbs are held in two places at once.

name: Breach Cut
description: Cut through the breach and let the stroke reach the foe from nowhere.

name: Breach Guard
description: Open a breach before the blow so it passes through and out elsewhere.

name: Breach Lance
description: Thrust a lance through a breach so it strikes from the foe's blind side.

name: Breach Ward
description: Hold a ring of small breaches about the user that swallow blows and quicken the user's steps.

name: Breach Burst
description: Open a hundred breaches about the foes at once and let their edges strike together.

name: Breach Storm
description: The school's closing move that opens breach after breach until the field is a storm of cutting space.

name: Tilt Step
description: Tilt the ground ahead and let the body slide down it to a new place.

name: Tilt Jab
description: Jab along a tilted line so the fist arrives from above the foe's guard.

name: Tilt Reading
description: Feel which way the ground and air lean and where a foe has set their weight.

name: Tilt Pull
description: Tip the space about a foe and draw their weight over their toes.

name: Tilt Cut
description: Cut along a tilted plane so the foe slides off the line of their own stance.

name: Tilt Brace
description: Tilt the space before the body so a heavy blow glances up and away.

name: Tilt Poise
description: Hold the user's own space level while all else tilts so each move stays sure.

name: Tilt Drive
description: Drive a tilted wedge of space under a foe's stance and up through the guard.

name: Tilt Guard
description: Tilt a great wall of space over the user so charges slide up it and fall short.

name: Tilt Collapse
description: Tilt a wide field until all footing fails and foes fall together toward one low point.

name: Tilt Ruin
description: The school's closing move that tips the whole world beneath the foes and pours them down it.

name: Emptied Stride
description: Hollow out the ground ahead of the foot and step across the emptiness.

name: Emptied Strike
description: Strike with a palm that hollows the air in its path so nothing slows it.

name: Emptied Sense
description: Listen for the hollow that a hidden foe leaves in the space about them.

name: Emptied Bind
description: Hollow the space at a foe's knees so the legs are drawn in and held.

name: Emptied Slice
description: Cut through a hollow so the stroke meets no resistance until it reaches the foe.

name: Emptied Guard
description: Hollow the space in the blow's path so it falls through and past the body.

name: Emptied Spear
description: Drive a lance down a hollowed line so it meets no hindrance on its way.

name: Emptied Shroud
description: Wrap the user in a hollow shroud where lesser strikes find nothing to strike.

name: Emptied Rupture
description: Hollow the space inside a foe's guard until the whole stance caves in upon itself.

name: Emptied Diadem
description: The school's closing move that hollows a ring about the foe's head and closes it in a crown.

name: Seamless Step
description: Pass between two points in a step with no seam between them.

name: Seamless Palm
description: Strike so the palm and the target seem to share one space.

name: Seamless Gauge
description: Take in the whole field as one piece and gauge every body in it together.

name: Seamless Bind
description: Join the foe's space to the ground so their limbs cannot part from it.

name: Seamless Cut
description: Cut where no seam shows and leave the foe to find the wound later.

name: Seamless Guard
description: Close every seam about the body so a blow finds no weak point to enter.

name: Seamless Lance
description: Drive a lance through the field as if near and far were one place.

name: Seamless Ward
description: Hold a ward in which every ally is joined to the user and moves with sure grace.

name: Seamless Sever
description: Cut the foe from the space about them and leave them without footing or bearing.

name: Seamless Whole
description: The school's closing move that joins every point of the field into one whole under the user's hand.
